name: Emulation
description: The adversary applies emulation which enables him to use one computer system to behave like another computer system, e.g. Android.

subtechniques.name: Machine emulator and virtualizer
subtechniques.description: Emulators and virtualization might be used to use specific operating systems.

procedures.name: AnBox
procedures.description: AnBox is a container-based approach to boot a full Android system on a regular GNU/Linux system like Ubuntu. AnBox will let you run Android on your Linux system without the slowness of virtualization. https://github.com/anbox/anbox

subtechniques.name: Quick EMUlator (QEMU)
subtechniques.description: QEMU A generic and open source machine emulator and virtualizer. Features. Full-system emulation. Run operating systems for any machine, on any supported architecture. User-mode emulation. Run programs for another Linux/BSD target, on any supported architecture.

procedures.name: Nox
procedures.description: Nox is an Android emulator for PC & Mac. https://www.bignox.com/
